messages:
sara_mkt: Quick debrief — finished the Kitewell interview. They gave a tight line we could use in the case post: "Redwood helped us cut inference spend while keeping latency steady." Need legal review + comms OK, and webinar routing.

ben_p: Nice. Can you paste the exact quote and attach the clip? Ill make a 15s teaser.

sara_mkt: Raw quote: "Redwood helped us cut inference spend while keeping latency steady under load." Audio uploaded to Files.

laura_legal: Suggest soften absolute claims unless customer confirms numbers. Recommend: "significantly reduced per-inference cost while maintaining stable latency". Need comms sign-off and signed release attached.

amy_cs: They signed the standard release. Ill ping their PR for the softened wording and the attribution line.

tom_se: For routing, Ill create the SFDC campaign and HubSpot form. What fields?

ben_p: email, company, role, use_case, interest_level, attended_webinar (Y/N), plus utm params. Webhook to enrichment service too.

amy_cs: PR approved the softened quote and provided attribution: "Jordan Lee, VP Platform, Kitewell". Also asked for a link to their public benchmark repo and no competitor callouts. No embargo.

publish-bot: Checklist: release attached, comms approval, SFDC campaign created, assets uploaded.

sara_mkt: Landing copy updated, quote block set to legal-approved wording, assets attached. Planning to open registration Mon 09:00 PT, webinar Thu 10:00 PT.

ben_p: Great. Ill schedule promos and A/B social headlines once you confirm the final landing CTA.

sara_mkt: CTA set to "See the case study + webinar". Marking thread resolved. Thanks team! :tada:
